people.name: Asaph
people.line: Levite musician, psalmist, and ancestor of temple singers

people.name: Benaiah
people.line: A Levite of the sons of Asaph, filled with the Spirit.

people.name: Jahaziel
people.line: Levite who prophesied Jehoshaphat's victory over his enemies.

people.name: Jeiel
people.line: Grandfather of Jahaziel, a Levite during Jehoshaphat's reign.

people.name: Levi
people.line: Son of Jacob; progenitor of the Levites

people.name: Mattaniah
people.line: Levite, grandfather of Jahaziel, who prophesied during Jehoshaphat's reign.

people.name: Zechariah
people.line: Levite who prophesied during Jehoshaphat's reign

translations.web: Then Yahweh’s Spirit came on Jahaziel the son of Zechariah, the son of Benaiah, the son of Jeiel, the son of Mattaniah, the Levite, of the sons of Asaph, in the middle of the assembly;
translations.bsb: Then the Spirit of the LORD came upon Jahaziel son of Zechariah, the son of Benaiah, the son of Jeiel, the son of Mattaniah, a Levite from Asaph’s descendants, as he stood in the midst of the assembly.
translations.kjv: Then upon Jahaziel the son of Zechariah, the son of Benaiah, the son of Jeiel, the son of Mattaniah, a Levite of the sons of Asaph, came the Spirit of the LORD in the midst of the congregation;
translations.asv: Then upon Jahaziel the son of Zechariah, the son of Benaiah, the son of Jeiel, the son of Mattaniah, the Levite, of the sons of Asaph, came the Spirit of Jehovah in the midst of the assembly;
